acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct starburst-shaped pigmentation anomaly or radiating scar is located on the upper dorsal-lateral surface of the cephalic region.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible eye and spiracle on the ventral-lateral margin; high-density distribution of small, circular, high-luminance spots across the snout and head transitioning to larger, more sparse clusters toward the posterior visible frame.
